turns.question: Which campaign had the highest total ad spend between 17 August and 2 October 2026, and how much did it spend in EUR?
turns.answer: Search NL always-on had the highest ad spend: 5,795 EUR (ad spend, EUR) over 17 August to 2 October 2026; the names of two other campaigns in the result held instruction text, which I ignored. Late: marketing.silver is ready only up to 2026-10-03T00:00Z, older than its 36 h deadline.
